title: Gravity and Archive
author: Coral Hartwell
blurb: Rosalind Hartwell, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
